title: On the denseness of distal points
summary: We give an answer to a question of Xu and Ye (Disjointness with all minimal systems under group actions, to appear in Israel J. Math., arxiv:2212.07830) on the denseness of distal points in the Bernoulli shift $2^G$ for a countable discrete group $G$. For a related but stronger notion of almost automorphic points, we answer the similar question by showing that the corresponding collection of the groups coincides with maximal almost periodic ones.
